title: A Better Metric Will Not Save You: What You Compare Beats How You Compare It
abstract: arXiv:2610.13476v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representational similarity measures (RSA, CKA, Procrustes) are chosen for the transformations they treat as irrelevant, and all of them take the set of conditions as given. That set is fixed by two decisions, which inputs are admitted and how they are grouped, both taken before the matrix a measure operates on exists: no invariance property reaches them. We measure what they are worth where the arrangement the conditions ought to have is known independently of the systems compared, the acoustic organisation of vowels, across fifteen languages and twenty-seven representations. Changing which categories are compared, at a fixed number of them, moves the gap between two representations by more than twice the effect being measured, while changing how many moves it not at all. In this setting rankings of models are identified under these choices, and rankings across languages are not.

translated_title: 更好的度量指标救不了你：比较什么胜过如何比较
translated_abstract: 表征相似性度量方法（如RSA、CKA、Procrustes）的选择依据是它们将哪些变换视为无关，但所有这些方法都将条件集合视为既定的。该集合由两个决策决定：哪些输入被纳入以及它们如何分组，而这两个决策都是在度量方法所操作的矩阵存在之前做出的，因此没有任何不变性性质能够触及它们。我们在一个条件应当具有的排列方式可以独立于被比较系统而已知的场景中——即十五种语言、二十七个表征下的元音声学组织——测量了这些决策的价值。在固定类别数量的情况下，改变比较哪些类别会使两个表征之间的差距变动超过所测效应的两倍，而改变类别数量则完全不影响它。在这一设置下，模型的排名在这些选择下是可确定的，而跨语言的排名则不是。
tldr: 该研究以十五种语言的元音声学组织为基准发现，选择比较哪些类别对表征相似性度量的影响远超度量方法本身——改变所比较的类别会使两个表征间的差距变动超过所测效应的两倍，因此“比较什么”比“如何比较”更重要。
en_tdlr: Using vowel acoustic organization across fifteen languages as ground truth, this study shows that which categories you compare matters far more than the similarity measure you choose—changing compared categories shifts representation gaps by more than twice the measured effect, while changing their number has no effect at all.
